= AsciiDoc Integration Specification
Cairn Core Team
:description: Technical specification for AsciiDoc parsing and editor streaming in Cairn
:tags: documentation, spec, formats, asciidoc

== Executive Summary

This document specifies the parsing rules and behavioral expectations for `.adoc` and `.asciidoc`
files within Cairn vaults. Refer to xref:quantum-state-collapse.typ[Quantum State Collapse].

[NOTE]
====
AsciiDoc files participate fully in the knowledge graph, backlink indexing, and full-text search.
====

== Structural Syntax [#sec-syntax]

AsciiDoc uses level markers (`=`, `==`, `===`) for document and section titles:

- Title level 1: `= Document Title`
- Section level 2: `== Section Name`
- Subsection level 3: `=== Detail Subtopic`

=== Cross References and Wikilinks

Traditional AsciiDoc links use `xref:` or inline anchors:

* Cross reference to anchor: <<sec-syntax,Syntax Section>>
* Cross reference to Typst paper: xref:quantum-state-collapse.typ[Quantum State Collapse]
* Native Cairn Wikilink: [[cairn-roadmap]]
* Link to project architecture: [[Project Cairn Architecture]]

[TIP]
====
Wikilinks work universally across `.md`, `.org`, `.typ`, and `.adoc` files in Cairn.
====
